# FF/FL floor flatness calculator

> Free, open-source FF/FL calculator for concrete floors: reads elevation readings taken every 12 inches (typed sample lines, a grid CSV from a laser level or total station, or a laser-scan point cloud as x y z text), and works out FF flatness and FL levelness F-numbers after the ASTM E1155 method, per sample line, per section (all lines pooled) and overall (area-weighted). Checks them against specified overall and minimum local values, reports the largest gap under a straightedge laid along every line, draws a heat map and line profiles, and estimates how much grinding would lift FF to a target. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates, not engineering advice and not a test by a qualified testing agency. The FF and FL equations follow published secondary sources; the standard's own text was not read.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/floor-flatness/)
- [FF and FL numbers explained for concrete contractors, with a line worked by hand](https://marisstella.app/floor-flatness/ff-fl-for-concrete-contractors.html)

## Method

- FF = 4.57 / (3 S_q + |mean q|), q = change in 12-in slope between neighbouring readings (inches).
- FL = 12.5 / (3 S_d + |mean d|), d = elevation difference between readings 10 ft apart (inches).
- A missing reading splits a line; it is never bridged. Lines under 11 readings add nothing to FL.
- Grids are read along every row and every column; point clouds are resampled to a 12-in lattice (median of the points within a radius).

## Inputs

- Sample lines: one per row, `A1: 0.12 0.10 - 0.08`; `## Bay 3, area 2400` starts a section.
- Grid CSV: rows of elevations 12 in apart, empty cells for holes.
- Point cloud: `x y z` per row in one unit (in, mm, cm, ft or m).
- Optional: specified overall and minimum local FF/FL, straightedge length and allowed gap, a grind target FF.

## Source

- [Source code, CLI and README](https://github.com/duncan-haywood/oss-monorepo/tree/main/ventures/floor-flatness): FSL-1.1-MIT licensed. `node cli.mjs readings.csv --ff 35 --fl 25 --grind 40`.
